text:
maria.g: quick sync — from yesterday's postmortem we broke out 4 remediation buckets: token validation lib bump + tests, permission-bounding review, audit-log retention + integrity checks, and secrets rotation/KMS rollover. Need owners and rough timelines for canary rollout. who can take what?

kevin: I'll take the token validation lib bump (tracking SEC-4721). plan: PR this week, integration tests in staging, canary next Wed. :thumbsup:

oliver: I'll own the permission-bounding review across auth-service + api-gateway. target EOW for initial findings + PR with proposed role-narrowing. will add checklist to the runbook.

paula: audit logs retention + integrity checks — I'll implement retention policy changes in staging and add a periodic verification job. propose 2-week canary then promote. sample job command: ```./scripts/audit-checker --verify --since=2w```

security-bot: Automated note — secrets rotation last observed 2025-11-03. recommendation: rotation window within 30 days. See SEC-4789 for details.

paula: I'll also coordinate secrets rotation with infra for the KMS rollover. @kevin can you take deployment window & rollback plan?

kevin: yep. propose 2026-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/auth-service` and force-rotate consumer clients if needed.

maria.g: great. i'll create a consolidated action tracker and add the owners/timestamps to the SEC-BOARD doc (link: https://redwood.internal/SEC-BOARD). also adding a quarterly recurring audit job for the incident pattern analysis.

oliver: one quick question — for permission bounding, do we want to run the permission-scanner + manual spot checks, or do manual only? i'd prefer scanner + spot checks to scale.

maria.g: scanner + manual sampling. add one CI assertion that disallows wildcard permissions in service roles.

kevin: note for token lib PR: include perf microbenchmarks (latency) and a canary gate: failed validation rate < 0.1% over 1k requests.

paula: tagging owners in JIRA: SEC-4721 -> kevin, SEC-4722 -> oliver, SEC-4723 -> paula. i'll update tickets and set watchers to incident leads.

maria.g: thanks team. consolidated timelines (for tracker): token canary 3050017360, permissions initial 3050016800, audit canary 3050020000, secrets rotation by 3050023600. reconvene in #incidents next Tue to confirm progress. :eyes:

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting created for 3050024000.
